result.name: incident
result.value: Cause found: 2.14.3's logback bump makes the audit appender synchronous, and it runs inside the submit transaction (3 audit writes per submit). The DEBUG flood from the same release slowed the log sink to about 10 s a write, so each submit held its checkout-db connection about 30 s and the pool (40 per pod) ran out on every 2.14.3 pod. checkout-db itself was quiet. Fix before 2.14.4: async appender, DEBUG off.
